heading: CLAUDE FABLE 5 WILL BE INCLUDED IN ALL MAX AND TEAM PREMIUM PLANS (1 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Claude Fable 5 will be included in all Max and Team Premium plans at 50% of limits starting July 20. Pro and Team Standard users will continue to have access to Fable via usage credits. They will receive a one-time $100 credit. Fable is being rolled out in stages as demand for the model has been challenging to predict.
